# Victor Deglon — Volleyball Recruiting Profile

> Opposite hitter recruiting profile: measurables, film, schedule, and
> academics. Low-cost navigation hint for AI crawlers — no major AI
> company has publicly committed to reading llms.txt as of early 2026, so
> treat this as a bonus, not a ranking lever.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://victor.deglon.ai/): Name, position, class year, height/reach, video, one-line pitch.
- [Stats / Measurables](https://victor.deglon.ai/stats/): Dated physical and skill numbers.
- [Film](https://victor.deglon.ai/film/): Highlight reel and full-match film links.
- [Schedule](https://victor.deglon.ai/schedule/): Upcoming tournaments and showcases.
- [Academics](https://victor.deglon.ai/academics/): GPA, test scores, intended major, NCAA Eligibility Center status.
- [About](https://victor.deglon.ai/about/): Bio, work ethic, leadership.
- [Log](https://victor.deglon.ai/log/): Dated updates after each tournament — the freshness signal for this site.
- [Training](https://victor.deglon.ai/training/): Training system and quantified development.
- [Contact](https://victor.deglon.ai/contact/): Recruiting contact.
